testCases.title: Verify Required Fields in Contact Form
steps: Check that all required fields are displayed in the contact form.

testCases.title: Verify Subject Dropdown Options
steps: Check the options in the subject dropdown.
expectedResults: The subject dropdown contains the specified options.

testCases.title: Verify Validation Error for Short Message
steps: Fill in the required fields with valid data.
Enter a message with fewer than 50 characters.
expectedResults: A validation error is shown indicating the message must be at least 50 characters.

testCases.title: Verify Confirmation Message After Submission
steps: Fill in all required fields with valid data.
Enter a message with 50 characters or more.
expectedResults: A confirmation message is displayed after successfully submitting the contact form.
